title: Mid-Term Cancellation and Expiry Provisions, Commercial & Property Manager Service Agreements
content:
**Provision.** The agreement must be in active status when it is cancelled. Cancelling is the customer's own act and takes effect after the tier's cancellation notice days. On tiers with an early termination fee, the fee is the tier's percentage of the additional site fees the remaining term would still have carried; on tiers whose annual fee is refundable, the unused part of the annual fee is credited, prorated by the days remaining after the effective date over the proration basis days, rounded to the cent, half up. An agreement that reaches its term end without renewal expires.

These provisions govern how an agreement under the Commercial & Property Manager Service Agreements ends, by cancellation mid-term or by expiry.

## Clauses

**C.1 Status.** An agreement is cancelled only while its record shows active status.

**C.2 Who cancels and when it takes effect.** Cancelling is the customer's own act. It takes effect after the tier's cancellation notice days, the calendar days of written notice the tier requires to cancel mid-term. On cancellation the agreement moves from active to cancelled status.

**C.3 Early termination fee.** On tiers with an early termination fee, the fee is the tier's early termination percentage of the additional site fees the remaining term would still have carried. It is charged once per agreement.

**C.4 Unused annual fee.** On tiers whose annual fee is refundable, the unused part of the annual fee is credited to the agreement, prorated by the days remaining after the effective date over the proration basis days, rounded to the cent, half up. The credit is booked once for the cancelled term.

**C.5 Expiry.** An agreement that reaches its term end without renewal expires, moving from active to expired status.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs, not any tier's figures)

- **Unused annual fee.** With an annual fee of 1,000.00, 100 days remaining after the effective date and a proration basis of 365 days, the credit is 1,000.00 multiplied by 100 and divided by 365, which is 273.9726..., rounded half up to 273.97.
- **Early termination fee.** With an illustrative early termination percentage of 20 and additional site fees of 600.00 that the remaining term would still have carried, the fee is 20 percent of 600.00, which is 120.00.

## Points of judgement

- An agreement whose record shows suspended or expired status is not in active status and is not cancelled under C.1.
- On a tier that both charges an early termination fee and refunds the annual fee, cancellation books both: the fee under C.3 and the credit under C.4.
- An agreement that is not renewed is not cancelled; it expires at its term end under C.5.
